messages.subject: For Lyndon Arnall | Sustainability, stakeholder strategy and responsible copper growth
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Steeves,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Lyndon Arnall, Executive Vice President and Chief Legal & Sustainability Officer.

Teck's copper and critical-minerals portfolio places sustainability, stakeholder confidence and disciplined external execution close to long-term value creation. Those priorities align closely with the operating interface I lead today across government, regulators, communities, ESG and executive management.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I translate external commitments into accountable internal owners, evidence, deadlines and escalation across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, and I coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this operating-side experience might support Teck's sustainability, stakeholder, external-affairs or country-level priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Teck and the contribution I believe I could make.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
